view34: pass — flat floor runner seen in 3/4 top-down view (4/4 gate runs passed view34) with top and bottom gold borders, end fringe tassels, and subtle south fringe contact shadow.
style: pass — woven crimson field with staggered highlight knots, 4-tone gold/umber braided border and inner runner stripes, 7 tones per tile, 0% flat fill, and dark warm-brown material outlines with zero black sticker edges.
reasons: Reads clearly as a 3-wide royal carpet runner lying flat on the castle stone floor with distinct fringed top/bottom ends and a repeatable middle section.

Uses the locked Beodeul palette (4 gold/umber steps #714210-#845c1f-#aa7a08-#fbc10d plus 3 crimson weave steps #a40100-#9e2514-#dd2912 bordered by #714210 umber shadow) with woven texture, no flat fills, and no sticker outline.
Vertical tiling across row 15->16 and row 31->32 preserves the 1px weave parity and the 4px cadence of gold studs and crimson knots without any seam in the 5-tile room scene.
